title: In the Midnight Hour
blurb: The Rio Nido dance hall Midnight Hour — Pigpen preaching over a half-hour R&B vamp while the band learns what it means to stretch a song past its edges.

title: Dark Star > St. Stephen > The Eleven > Turn On Your Love Light
blurb: The Live/Dead sequence, caught at the Fillmore West: the definitive Dark Star flowing through St. Stephen and The Eleven into Pigpen's Lovelight — the ur-text of the psychedelic Dead.

title: Dark Star > The Other One > Turn On Your Love Light
blurb: The late show at the Fillmore East: a crystalline Dark Star — later woven into Grayfolded — crashing into The Other One and a marathon Lovelight in the small hours of Valentine's Day.

title: Truckin' > Caution (Do Not Stop on Tracks)
blurb: Wembley's second night, early Europe '72: Truckin' boils over into a ferocious Caution — Pigpen's last great rave-up era, and a run reviewers single out on every tape of this show.

title: Dark Star > Drums > The Other One
blurb: The Rotterdam marathon: Dark Star and The Other One joined at the hip for the better part of an hour — Europe '72 at its most fearless and far out.

title: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
blurb: The Veneta China > Rider: sun-blasted, joyous, and locked-in — the classic pairing at the peak of its 1972 stride.

title: The Veneta Dark Star
blurb: Played in 100-degree Oregon heat at the Springfield Creamery benefit — for many Heads the single greatest Dark Star ever performed.

title: The Philadelphia Dark Star
blurb: The Spectrum Dark Star — half an hour of patient, exploratory playing that tape collectors rank with Veneta among the best of the year.

title: Scarlet Begonias > Fire on the Mountain
blurb: The Cornell Scarlet > Fire: the transition every other version is measured against — patient, melodic, and perfectly recorded on the Betty board.

title: The Cornell Morning Dew
blurb: Barton Hall's closing statement: a Morning Dew that builds to one of Garcia's most shattering peaks — the reason this tape became legend.

title: Help on the Way > Slipknot! > Franklin's Tower
blurb: The night after Cornell, Buffalo opens with a Help > Slip > Franklin's so assured it steals the whole May '77 conversation for many listeners.

title: The JFK Morning Dew
blurb: From the Crimson, White & Indigo stand at JFK Stadium: a late-eighties Morning Dew with the full weight of the big-stadium Dead behind it.

title: The Hampton Dark Star
blurb: Billed as 'Formerly the Warlocks': the house lights drop, the first Dark Star in five years opens, and Hampton Coliseum comes apart at the seams.

title: Eyes of the World with Branford Marsalis
blurb: Branford Marsalis sits in at Nassau and the band lifts to meet him — an Eyes of the World widely held as the finest of the modern era.

title: The Unbroken Chain Breakout
blurb: Twenty-one years after Mars Hotel, Philadelphia gets the first live Unbroken Chain — the crowd realizes what's happening a few bars in and the roar is on every tape.
